sweetbird.heroDescription: Creative syrups and frappés crafted in Bristol, UK — trusted by baristas for bold flavour and consistent quality.
sweetbird.aboutText: Born in Bristol, UK in 2006 — Sweetbird set out to challenge convention by creating extraordinary syrups and smoothies. Over 18 years later, the award-winning range delivers exceptional taste with versatility and simplicity. BRC Global Standard accredited for food safety.
sweetbird.ctaHeading: Interested in Sweetbird for your business?

zuma.heroDescription: Premium café beverage solutions — rich hot chocolate, authentic matcha, and aromatic chai for professional baristas.
zuma.aboutText: Zuma creates premium café beverage solutions — from rich, indulgent hot chocolate to authentic Japanese matcha and aromatic chai. Designed for baristas who want consistent quality and bold flavour in every cup.
zuma.ctaHeading: Interested in Zuma for your business?

thebridge.heroDescription: Italian organic plant-based drinks, since 1994 — a Barista range formulated to froth, steam, and pour like dairy.
thebridge.aboutText: An Italian organic pioneer — The Bridge has been producing plant-based drinks since 1994. Their Barista range is specifically formulated for professional coffee service: it froths, steams, and pours like dairy, with clean organic ingredients.

coffeeShops.heroSubtitle: Premium beverages and ingredients for your café
coffeeShops.problemText: Running a café means balancing quality with consistency. Your baristas need reliable plant-based milk that froths perfectly, syrups that taste the same every cup, and specialty ingredients your customers can't find elsewhere. 3PLUS brings you selected European brands trusted by professionals — delivered on schedule.
coffeeShops.ctaHeading: Ready to supply your coffee shop?

hotelsRestaurants.heroSubtitle: Beverage and breakfast solutions for hospitality
hotelsRestaurants.problemHeading: Why choose 3PLUS for your hotel or restaurant
hotelsRestaurants.problemText: Hotels and restaurants need more than good food — they need a beverage program that runs smoothly across breakfast service, room service, and the bar. 3PLUS supplies plant-based alternatives, premium hot chocolate, chai, and flavoured syrups from one source, one invoice, one delivery.
hotelsRestaurants.ctaHeading: Ready to supply your hotel or restaurant?

bakeries.problemText: Bakeries and dessert shops need ingredients that perform — real chocolate sauce for drizzling, matcha powder that holds its colour, frappé base that blends smoothly. 3PLUS sources professional-grade ingredients from European producers, so your recipes stay consistent batch after batch.
